turns.utterance: Do you see any magazine deformation, cracked pockets, or broken gripper fingers?

turns.utterance: Measure the diameter of each locating pin at the shank and at the nose using a calibrated digital micrometer. Compare against the nominal pin diameter and the minimum serviceable diameter, then inspect the pin surface under a magnifier for any chipping, burring, or scoring.

ground_truth.node_text: Measure the diameter of each locating pin at the shank and at the nose using a calibrated digital micrometer. Compare against the nominal pin diameter and the minimum serviceable diameter in the fixture drawing. Inspect the pin surface under a magnifier for chipping, burring, or scoring; any pin showing surface damage at the locating nose should be replaced.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Pin measurements recorded. All diameters are within the serviceable range and surfaces are clean with no damage.

ground_truth.node_text: Measure the diameter of each locating pin at the shank and at the nose using a calibrated digital micrometer. turns.utterance: The retention force is reading below the minimum specification on multiple pockets.

turns.utterance: Perform a secondary drawbar overhaul. ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification. Replace the complete spring stack with new springs from the correct part number kit. Reset the drawbar preload to the specification value using a compression gauge before returning to the tool retention force measurement step.

turns.speaker: operator
turns.utterance: Drawbar overhaul complete. Found several cracked springs in the stack, replaced the entire assembly, and preload is now set correctly.

ground_truth.node_text: Secondary drawbar overhaul: extend the drawbar to expose the disc spring stack and inspect each spring for cracking, deformation, or dimensional out of specification.
